waypoints.name: Killen Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Randle, drive south 1 mile on FR 25, bear left onto FR 23 and follow it about 32 miles to FR 2329, signed for Takhlakh Lake Campground. Turn onto FR 2329 and continue about 4.5 miles past Takhlakh Lake to the Killen Creek trailhead; from Trout Lake, FR 23 reaches the same FR 2329 junction in about 24 miles. FR 2329 is gravel and holds snow into early summer. A Northwest Forest Pass and a free self-issued wilderness permit are required.

waypoints.name: High Camp
waypoints.directions: Follow Killen Creek Trail #113 through forest, meadow and huckleberry fields, crossing East Fork Adams Creek (the last dependable water) about 2.5 miles up, to the PCT junction at roughly 6,100 ft. Cross straight over onto High Camp Trail #10 and follow it about another mile to its end on the edge of the Adams Glacier moraine, where camps are spread between 7,000 and 7,600 ft.
